rules.text: An offsite is max 3 days and 2 nights.
The budget is up to 4,000 ILS per person, including flights, hotel, food and activities. Anything above that needs the CFO's approval.
Don't pick dates that fall on a holiday in Israel or a public holiday in the destination country.
Every team meal needs an option for everyone's dietary needs.
All places and activities need to be accessible for everyone on the team.
Costs are planned in euros and reported in shekels, using the latest ECB rate.
